name: Grilled Cumin Chicken Thighs with Yogurt Sauce & Pita Salad (Fattoush)

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
3 tbsp water
¾ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a large bowl (reserve lemons for the dressing). Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with oil and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the marinade, and turn to coat; set aside.

Place pita breads on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the board, cut each pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into 1-inch pieces and place in another large bowl.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the pita; toss with your hands to coat. Divide between two large baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until the pita chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add chicken; grill until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
While the chicken cooks, juice the lemons into the reserved bowl; add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice cucumbers; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Just before serving, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl, along with pita chips, and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and chicken between plates or bowls; drizzle chicken with sauce and enjoy!
